en: A black‑and‑white studio portrait of a smiling young woman with wavy, light-colored hair, wearing a dark dress with large light buttons, light-colored gloves, and a beret-style hat. She is posed in a confident, slightly sideways seated position with her hands on her hips. The photo is framed by a white border, and beneath the image is printed the name "M. Zilava." There is a small printer's mark and number in the lower right corner of the margin.
